title: CCC — 100K final of the UTMB World Series (2026 race page)
claims: CCC is the 100K final of the UTMB World Series.
The 2026 CCC starts in Courmayeur on Friday 28 August 2026 at 09:00.
The maximum allowed race time is 28 hours.
The race page header states 108 km and 6,200 m of positive gain.
The official timing table totals 107.8 km with +6,198 m and -6,382 m.

The official timing table lists ten points: Courmayeur 0 km, Refuge Bertone 13.6 km, Arnouvaz 26.3 km, La Fouly 40.7 km, Champex-Lac sortie 54.2 km, Plan de l'Au 59.1 km, Martigny 69.2 km, Trient 79.1 km, Vallorcine Sortie 90.1 km and Chamonix 107.8 km.

Official altitudes are Courmayeur 1,221 m, Refuge Bertone 1,982 m, Arnouvaz 1,777 m, La Fouly 1,604 m, Champex-Lac 1,472 m, Plan de l'Au 1,340 m, Martigny 507 m, Trient 1,304 m, Vallorcine 1,260 m and Chamonix 1,035 m.

Official cumulative gain is +1,436 m at Refuge Bertone, +1,908 m at Arnouvaz, +2,774 m at La Fouly, +3,287 m at Champex-Lac, +3,361 m at Plan de l'Au, +3,526 m at Martigny, +4,603 m at Trient, +5,411 m at Vallorcine and +6,198 m at Chamonix.

The official 2026 loss column reads 677, 673, 1,042, 644, 208, 996, 281, 852 and 1,009 m; these nine values sum to 6,382 m, so the column is read as per-segment loss, while cumulative loss is 677, 1,350, 2,392, 3,036, 3,244, 4,240, 4,521, 5,373 and 6,382 m.

Official cut-off times are Friday 13:45 at Refuge Bertone, 16:30 at Arnouvaz, 20:15 at La Fouly, 23:15 at Champex-Lac, Saturday 00:15 at Plan de l'Au, 02:15 at Martigny, 05:15 at Trient, 08:30 at Vallorcine and 13:30 at Chamonix.
The official table also lists fastest and slowest reference times; at Trient, Vallorcine and Chamonix the slowest time is later than the cut-off time.

The course climbs to about 2,500 m facing Mont Blanc and the Grandes Jorasses, crosses the Grand Col Ferret into Switzerland, passes La Fouly, Champex and Trient, re-enters France at Vallorcine, climbs Vallons des Chezerys and finishes in Chamonix.
The 2027 edition is in preparation; event dates and registration opening dates will be announced.
The official services legend lists assistance, hot meal, solid refreshments, liquid refreshments, Näak, medical post, drop bag, shuttle bus, toilets, showers and rest area.
The organiser describes CCC as having grown from the 'little sister of the UTMB' into one of the most prestigious races in the world.
The CCC page states that entry is open to runners with Running Stones or by direct entry from winning a UTMB World Series race.

verification.note: Official race page rendered and read in a browser on 2026-11-08. The page states the 2027 edition is in preparation, so this record describes the 2026 edition.
